name: Oumi
summary: Apache-2.0 end-to-end foundation-model platform for training, evaluation, inference and agentic/tool-use post-training, installable as PyPI oumi 0.9.
description: Established project (repo oumi-ai/oumi; not archived; created 2024-05-07; not a 2026 launch). Root LICENSE is Apache-2.0. PyPI oumi 0.9 verified 2026-11-12 (not yanked; wheel uploaded 2026-09-16; project URLs point at this repository). README install: uv pip install oumi (optional oumi[gpu]), or pip; a git install is also documented. Docs at https://oumi.ai/docs/en/latest/index.html (HTTP 200). README news for v0.9 describes an end-to-end stack for agentic, tool-using models, including tool-calling SFT/DPO, executable tool environments, and GRPO over Oumi environments with verl. Executable environments can run tool or task code. GPU, cloud job runners (README mentions GCP, AWS, Azure, Lambda) and model-weight licenses are separate; no cloud accounts were used. Vendor: Oumi.

agent_access.notes: Python package: uv pip install oumi or pip install oumi. GPU extras and cloud runners are optional and were not used.
